[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Adds a subtle "snore" effect to NPCs who definitely snore. Chosen with objectivity.
At random intervals, they will subtly shake and play a custom breathing sound effect.


[center][youtube]cH8k_xY7KTc[/youtube][/center]

[b][size=4]TECHNICAL[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[b]List of NPCs[/b]
[spoiler]The NPCs who snore are Pierre, Abigail, Shane, Pam, Robin, Clint, and Willy.[/spoiler]

[b]Unique Interactions[/b]
[spoiler]When Pierre is sleeping next to Caroline, there is a small chance she will "wake up" and emote.
When Demetrius is sleeping next to Robin, there is a small chance he will display a heart emote.[/spoiler]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[spoiler]I don't know if Willy sleeps. And tbh, I do not care. But I check his room in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].
I added in a pseudo-compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34252]Star Crossed[/url], in the event Abigail moves in with Sebastian.[/spoiler]
